title: 28% Of Americans Now Claim No Religion
hook: No religion now describes 28% of Americans, passing Catholics.
closing: No religion is reshaping communities as younger generations replace older ones.
question: Do you consider yourself religious?

segments.say: No religion described just 8 percent of US adults. That share has more than tripled.
No religion describes 36 percent of millennials, making the shift strongest among younger adults.
No religion now describes 28 percent of Americans, passing Catholics and trailing only Protestants.
